title: Solanki Subterranean Art & Double-Ikat Silk
description: Follow the sacred waters and silk looms of Patan in northern Gujarat: from the seven carved tiers and Vishnu avatar sculptures of Rani ki Vav to the generational Salvi weavers practicing double-ikat Patola silk.

title: Desert Water Architecture & Mud-Resist Indigo
description: Traverse eastern Rajasthan connecting the dizzying 13-storey geometric staircases of Chand Baori at Abhaneri with the living communal mud-resist (dabu) and natural indigo printing courtyards of Bagru.

title: Marwar Citadel to Jaipur Craft Enclave
description: Cross the desert corridor between Jodhpur and Jaipur: marvel at the sheer cliff-top sandstone ramparts and jharokha latticework of Mehrangarh Fort, then witness the delicate hand-carved wooden block textile traditions of Bagru.

title: Western India Grand Cultural Circuit
description: The definitive five-point heritage voyage across Rajasthan and Gujarat: descending into the geometric depths of Chand Baori, exploring Bagru's indigo vats, ascending Mehrangarh's bastions, learning Patan's mathematical silk weaving, and contemplating the inverted temple of Rani ki Vav.
